<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Letterhead xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <available>true</available>
    <backgroundColor>#FFFFFF</backgroundColor>
    <bodyColor>#FFFFFF</bodyColor>
    <description>Astound standard corporate letterhead</description>
    <footer>
        <backgroundColor>#333333</backgroundColor>
        <height>20</height>
    </footer>
    <header>
        <backgroundColor>#0071C5</backgroundColor>
        <height>40</height>
    </header>
    <name>Astound Letterhead</name>
    <topLine>
        <color>#0071C5</color>
        <height>1</height>
    </topLine>
</Letterhead>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<EmailTemplate xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <available>true</available>
    <encodingKey>UTF-8</encodingKey>
    <folderName>Lead_Notifications</folderName>
    <letterhead>Astound_Letterhead</letterhead>
    <name>Lead Routed Notification</name>
    <relatedEntityType>Lead</relatedEntityType>
    <subject>Your inquiry: {{{Lead.Company}}} — Reference {{{Lead.Id}}}</subject>
    <type>text</type>
    <uiType>Aloha</uiType>
</EmailTemplate>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Flow xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <apiVersion>61.0</apiVersion>
    <definition>
        <actionCalls>
            <name>Send_Notification_Email</name>
            <label>Send Notification Email</label>
            <locationX>400</locationX>
            <locationY>300</locationY>
            <actionName>emailSimple</actionName>
            <actionType>apex</actionType>
            <inputParameters>
                <name>EmailAddresses</name>
                <value>
                    <elementReference>$Record.Email</elementReference>
                </value>
            </inputParameters>
            <inputParameters>
                <name>EmailTemplate</name>
                <value>
                    <stringValue>Lead_Routed_Notification</stringValue>
                </value>
            </inputParameters>
            <inputParameters>
                <name>RecordId</name>
                <value>
                    <elementReference>$Record.Id</elementReference>
                </value>
            </inputParameters>
        </actionCalls>
        <decisions>
            <name>Check_Queue_Assignment</name>
            <label>Check Queue Assignment and Email</label>
            <locationX>300</locationX>
            <locationY>200</locationY>
            <defaultConnectorLabel>No Action</defaultConnectorLabel>
            <rules>
                <name>Is_Sales_Queue</name>
                <conditionLogic>and</conditionLogic>
                <conditions>
                    <leftValueReference>$Record.Owner:Queue.QueueName</leftValueReference>
                    <operator>EqualTo</operator>
                    <rightValue>
                        <stringValue>Sales_Queue</stringValue>
                    </rightValue>
                </conditions>
                <conditions>
                    <leftValueReference>$Record.Email</leftValueReference>
                    <operator>IsNull</operator>
                    <rightValue>
                        <booleanValue>false</booleanValue>
                    </rightValue>
                </conditions>
                <connector>
                    <targetReference>Send_Notification_Email</targetReference>
                </connector>
            </rules>
        </decisions>
        <description>Sends email notification when Lead is assigned to Sales_Queue</description>
        <interviewLabel>Lead Assignment Notification</interviewLabel>
        <isTemplate>false</isTemplate>
        <label>Lead Assignment Notification</label>
        <processMetadataValues>
            <name>BuilderType</name>
            <value>
                <stringValue>LightningFlowBuilder</stringValue>
            </value>
        </processMetadataValues>
        <processType>AutoLaunchedFlow</processType>
        <recordTriggerType>RecordAfterSave</recordTriggerType>
        <recordUpdates/>
        <startElementReference>Check_Queue_Assignment</startElementReference>
        <status>Active</status>
        <triggerData>
            <isAllowedOnAllObjects>false</isAllowedOnAllObjects>
            <isChangedFilter>true</isChangedFilter>
            <object>Lead</object>
            <onAllChanges>false</onAllChanges>
            <onCreateOnly>false</onCreateOnly>
            <triggerEvents>
                <changeEvent>OwnerId</changeEvent>
            </triggerEvents>
        </triggerData>
    </definition>
    <description>Routes Leads to Sales_Queue with email notification</description>
    <masterLabel>Lead Assignment Notification</masterLabel>
</Flow>

# Email Notification Design: Lead Queue Routing

## Configuration Summary

**Scenario:** Lead assigned to Sales_Queue triggers branded email notification.

**Components Created:**
1. **Letterhead** (`Astound_Letterhead.letter-meta.xml`) — Branded header with corporate blue (#0071C5)
2. **Email Folder** (`Lead_Notifications-meta.xml`) — Container for templates
3. **Email Template** (`Lead_Routed_Notification.email-meta.xml` + `.email`) — Text template with merge fields for Lead.FirstName, Lead.Company, Lead.Phone, Lead.Id
4. **Flow** (`Lead_Assignment_Notification.flow-meta.xml`) — Record-triggered after-save on OwnerId change, guards on Queue name and email presence

## Recipient Selection
- **Field:** Lead.Email
- **Guard:** Non-null check prevents silent failures for records without email
- **Cross-object:** Owner.Queue.QueueName verification ensures queue-specific routing

## Transaction Behavior
- **Insert:** If created with Sales_Queue owner and email present → sends
- **Update:** OwnerId change to Sales_Queue (entry condition triggers only on OwnerId change) → sends
- **Idempotence:** Re-assigning to Sales_Queue fires again (intended; no deduplication)

## Negative Tests
- **MT-02:** Lead assigned to user (non-queue) → no email
- **MT-04:** Lead assigned to Sales_Queue, email blank → no email, no error (decision guards)
- **MT-05:** Lead assigned to different queue → no email

## Artifacts Saved
- `/home/tester/work/output/Astound_Letterhead.letter-meta.xml`
- `/home/tester/work/output/Lead_Notifications-meta.xml`
- `/home/tester/work/output/Lead_Routed_Notification.email-meta.xml`
- `/home/tester/work/output/Lead_Routed_Notification.email`
- `/home/tester/work/output/Lead_Assignment_Notification.flow-meta.xml`

**Note:** Design is synthetic/unsent. No connectors used; no Salesforce deployment executed.
